In a claim petition, onus is on the claimant(s)/ petitioner(s) to prove that he or she suffered injuries in a vehicular accident caused by the wrongful act or negligence of the driver of the offending vehicle.

10. In order to establish her claim, the petitioner Jyoti has examined herself as PW1.
11.

sentences.text: around 7.00 PM she was going from home to BK Hosptial, Faridabad by scooty for the treatment of petitioner's mother namely Nirmala who was seriously ill alongwith his brother.
The said scooty bearing registration no. HR-51BU-2458 was being driven by her brother namely Prakash.
Petitioner was pillion rider.

When they reached at Old Faridabad Bus Stand, petitioner felt that his mother was serious and decided to admit her in some private hospital nearby and then moved from old fariabad towards Sec. 28 Faridabad.

When the petitioner reached near Sector 28 Metro Station, NH-2, Delhi suddenly a vehicle i.e. truck bearing no. HR-55N-6602 which was coming in a high speed and in a rash and negligent manner hit the petitioner's scooty from back side, with a great force as a result of which petitioner fell down on the road alongwith scooty and her mother and brother.
The offending vehicle ran over the legs of her mother and petitioner received multiple injuries all over her body as per the treatment records.
Petitioner noted the number of offending vehicle when it stopped for a few minutes, thereafter offending vehicle flee from the place of accident.
The petitioner alongwith her brother and mother were shifted to Asian Hospital, Faridabad by the people who gathered there.
After the first aid petitioner alongwith her mother namely Nirmala Devi referred to JPN Apex Trauma Centre, New Delhi and remain under treatment, thereafter her mother died.

However, he has preferred not to enter into the witness box during the course of the inquiry.

23. However as per the version of the petitioner herself there were two pillion riders travelling on the scooty which is in violation of Section 128 MV Act.
Hence, there is no doubt that it is a case of contributory negligence.
It has also come up on record that medical condition of the petitioner's mother was very serious and that is why she was being taken to the hospital on the date of accident.
During the travel, her mother's condition got deteriorated and the petitioner changed the route to take her to the nearest hospital on the way to which the accident took place.

sentences.text: It is an admitted position on record that the vehicle was insured with respondent no.3, therefore, respondent no. 3 becomes contractually liable to compensate the petitioners/claimants for the amount.

28. However, it is clear in the evidence of the injured that there were two pillion riders on the scooty bearing no. HR- 51BU-2458 which is violation of Section 128 MV Act, therefore, this Court is satisfied that the injured has also contributed in causing the accident and her compensation should be reduced to the extent of ten percent only which she would have been awarded after considering the situation which has arisen due to serious medical condition of her mother.
Hence, compensation is reduced to the extent of ten percent.
29. Now the Court has to decide the compensation which the injured is entitled.
Injured in road traffic accident is entitled to damages for the injury suffered by her arising out of use of Motor Vehicle under both non-pecuniary and pecuniary heads.

sentences.text: However, the petitioner has not filed any document to show her income.

The petitioner has filed her educational qualification documents therefore, this Tribunal has no option but to take the wages for 'graduate and above' as applicable in Haryana where the petitioner lives and accident occurred.
The accident took place on 18.07.2019 and the minimum wages for an 'graduate and above'' as on the date of accident was Rs.10,446.65/- per month, rounded off to Rs.10,447/- p.m..
The injuries on the person of the petitioner were such that she must have remained out of work for least three months.

In a claim petition, onus is on the claimant(s)/ petitioner(s) to prove that he or she suffered injuries in a vehicular accident caused by the wrongful act or negligence of the driver of the offending vehicle.
Charge sheet has been filed against the respondent no.1.

No other version of accident has come on record except the one as narrated by injured.
